```{r}
# only want the patients in MITT analysis 
mitt_covid <- covid_out %>% filter(in_MITT_analysis == "Yes")

# Cardiovascular disease defined as hypertension, hyperlipidemia, coronary artery disease, past myocardial infarction, heart failure, pacemaker placement, arrhythmias, or pulmonary hypertension.
# make cardiovascular disease variable 
mitt_covid$cvd <- case_when(mitt_covid$pd_comorbidities___0 == "Yes" | 
                              mitt_covid$pd_comorbidities___2 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$pd_comorbidities___3 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$pd_comorbidities___4 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$pd_comorbidities___5 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$pd_comorbidities___10 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$pd_comorbidities___13 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$pd_comorbidities___21 == "Yes"
                              ~ "Yes", 
                            TRUE ~ "No")
# don't have a variable for symptom duration - ask about this 
#create bmi_cat > 30 
mitt_covid$bmi_cat <- case_when(mitt_covid$bmi >= 30 ~ "Yes", 
                                mitt_covid$bmi < 30 ~ "No", 
                                TRUE ~ NA)

mitt_covid$composite_primary_14 <- case_when(is.na(mitt_covid$screen_covid_vaccine) ~ NA, 
                              mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14 == "Yes" | 
                              mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "Yes" 
                              ~ "Yes", 
                              mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14 == "No" & 
                              mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14 == "No" &
                              mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "No" &
                              mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "No"  ~ "No",
                              TRUE ~ NA)


mitt_covid$ED_hosp_dead_14 <- case_when(is.na(mitt_covid$screen_covid_vaccine) ~ NA, 
                              mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "Yes" 
                              ~ "Yes", 
                              mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14 == "No" &
                              mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "No" &
                              mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "No"  ~ "No",
                              TRUE ~ NA)



mitt_covid$hosp_dead_14 <- case_when(is.na(mitt_covid$screen_covid_vaccine) ~ NA, 
                              mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "Yes" |
                              mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "Yes" 
                              ~ "Yes", 
                              mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "No" &
                              mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "No"  ~ "No",
                              TRUE ~ NA)

mitt_covid$hypoxemia_missingvax <- case_when(is.na(mitt_covid$screen_covid_vaccine) ~ NA, 
                                             TRUE ~ mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14)

mitt_covid$death_missingvax <- case_when(is.na(mitt_covid$screen_covid_vaccine) ~ NA, 
                                             TRUE ~ mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14)

# not combining hospitalization and death into one outcome
mitt_covid$ordinal_outcome5 <- case_when(is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14) &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14) &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14) &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) ~ NA,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "Yes" ~ 5, 
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 4,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 3,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 2,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14 == "No" & 
                                          mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14 == "No" & 
                                          mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "No" & 
                                          mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "No" ~ 1,
                                        TRUE ~ NA)

# not combining hospitalization and death into one outcome
mitt_covid$ordinal_outcome <- case_when(is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14) &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14) &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14) &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) ~ NA,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "Yes" ~ 4, 
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 4,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 3,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 2,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14 == "No" & 
                                          mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14 == "No" & 
                                          mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "No" & 
                                          mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "No" ~ 1,
                                        TRUE ~ NA)

mitt_covid$ordinal_outcome_all <- case_when(is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14) &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_2_by_d14) &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14) &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14) &

                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) ~ NA,

                                        mitt_covid$outcome_6_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 6,
                                        # mitt_covid$outcome_5_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                        #   is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_6_by_d14) == F &
                                        #   is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 6,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_5_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_6_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 5,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_5_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_6_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 4,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_2_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_4_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_5_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_6_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14) == F ~ 3,
                                        mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14 == "Yes" &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_2_by_d14) == F &
                                          is.na(mitt_covid$outcome_3_by_d14) == F &

                                        mitt_covid$outcome_1_by_d14 == "No" &

                                          mitt_covid$outcome_6_by_d14 == "No" & 
                                          mitt_covid$outcome_7_by_d14 == "No" ~ 1,
                                        TRUE ~ NA)


covid_dropped <- mitt_covid %>% drop_na(ordinal_outcome, ordinal_outcome_all)
table(covid_dropped$ordinal_outcome, covid_dropped$metformin, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r, echo = F}
covid_dropped$trt <- covid_dropped$metformin_5
# covid_dropped$ordinal_outcome_all <- as.integer(covid_dropped$ordinal_outcome_all)
a <- data_setup_LT(formula = ordinal_outcome_all ~ trt, 
                      ppo = ~ trt, 
                      data = covid_dropped, 
                stratum = 2)
fit_covid <- stan(
  file = "~/Documents/Dissertation/Paper 2/lrmcppo_LT.stan",  # Stan program
  data = a$d,    # named list of data
  chains = 4,             # number of Markov chains
  warmup = 1000,          # number of warmup iterations per chain
  iter = 2000,            # total number of iterations per chain
  cores = 4,              # number of cores (could use one per chain)
  refresh = 0             # no progress shown
  )

strat_est <- order_weighted_RD2_strat(stanfit = fit_covid, 
                                dat = covid_dropped, trt = "trt", outcome = "ordinal_outcome_all")

strat_cis <- order_weighted_RD2_CI_strat(stanfit = fit_covid, 
                                         dat = covid_dropped,
                                         trt = "metformin_5", outcome = "ordinal_outcome_all")
```

```{r, echo = F}
# sensitivity analyses
sensitivity_7level_2 <- sensitivity_utility_dichotomize(stanfit = fit_covid7,  structured_dat = a7,
                                dat = covid_dropped_dropvax, trt = "trt", outcome = "ordinal_outcome_all",
                           covs = c("ivermectin", "fluvoxamine", "screen_covid_vaccine"),
                           base_utility = c(100, 80, 65, 60, 40, 25, 0),
                           util_modify = 2)

sensitivity_CI_7level_2 <- sensitivity_utility_CI_dichotomize(stanfit = fit_covid7,  structured_dat = a7,
                                dat = covid_dropped_dropvax, trt = "trt", outcome = "ordinal_outcome_all",
                           covs = c("ivermectin", "fluvoxamine", "screen_covid_vaccine"),
                           base_utility = c(100, 80, 65, 60, 40, 25, 0),
                           util_modify = 2)

sensitivity_7level_2_adj <- as.data.frame(sensitivity_7level_2) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(weighted_RD_both, log_weighted_OR_both, log_weighted_RR_both, 
                        weighted_RD_util, log_weighted_OR_util, log_weighted_RR_util), 
               names_to = "Method", 
               values_to = "summary_measure") %>% 
  dplyr::select(utility_value, Method, summary_measure)
```

```{r, echo = F}
hypox_both <- as.data.frame(sensitivity_CI_7level_2) %>%

  pivot_wider(names_from = "CI", values_from = "summary_measure") %>% 
  rename(Lower = `2.5.`) %>% 
  rename(Upper = `97.5.`) %>% 
  mutate(Method = recode(Method, wRD_both_95CI = "weighted_RD_both",
         log_wOR_both_95CI = "log_weighted_OR_both",
         log_wRR_both_95CI = "log_weighted_RR_both"

  geom_ribbon(aes(x = utility_value, ymin=Lower, ymax=Upper, fill = Method), alpha=0.1, linetype = 2, fill = "black", col = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "longdash", col = "gray50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 80, linetype = "dotted", col = "gray50") +

  #                                     log_weighted_RR_both = "log wRR", 
  #                                     weighted_RD_both = "wRD")),

  #ggtitle("Varying Utility for ED Visit for Adjusted Model Day 14") +
```

```{r, echo = F}
hypox_both_droplevel <- as.data.frame(sensitivity_CI_7level_2_droplevel) %>%

  distinct(utility_value, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
```
```{r, echo = F}
  pivot_longer(cols = c(wRD_util_95CI.2.5., wRD_util_95CI.97.5.,

               values_to = "summary_measure") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Method_name, ".", names = c("Method", "CI"), too_many = "merge") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "CI", values_from = "summary_measure") %>% 
  rename(Lower = `2.5.`) %>% 
  rename(Upper = `97.5.`) %>% 
  mutate(Method = recode(Method, wRD_util_95CI = "weighted_RD_util",
         log_wOR_util_95CI = "log_weighted_OR_util",
         log_wRR_util_95CI = "log_weighted_RR_util"
     )) %>% 
  merge(sensitivity_7level_6_adj_droplevel, by = c("utility_value", "Method")) %>%
  filter(Method == "log_weighted_OR_util") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = utility_value, y = summary_measure, col = Method)) + geom_line(col = "black") +  
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = utility_value, ymin=Lower, ymax=Upper, fill = Method), fill = "black", col = "black", alpha=0.1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "longdash", col = "gray50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 25, linetype = "dotted", col = "gray50") +

  #ggtitle("Varying Utility for ED Visit for Adjusted Model Day 14") + 
  labs(y = "log(wOR)", x = "Utility Value of \n Hospitalization with Vent") + theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
```
